title: What If You Only Drank Seawater? Your Thirst Gets Worse

scenes.text: What if you drank seawater when you were thirsty? The more you drink, the thirstier you get.
About 3.5 percent of seawater's weight is dissolved salt. That's over three times the salt level in your blood.
Your kidneys can only make urine that is less salty than seawater, so they can't keep up.
To flush the extra salt, your body has to give up more water than you drank.
You need at least an equal amount of fresh water for each cup of seawater, just to flush the salt.
So you end up more dehydrated than before. You can die of dehydration, surrounded by water.
